title: Barramundi Bokkeum
description: A spicy Korean-style fish dish with smoky flavors, featuring barramundi as the main ingredient.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the barramundi fillets with salt and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fish and sprinkle with smoked paprika.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, heat 1 tablespoon of warm gochujang sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the brown sugar and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Remove the fish from the oven and place it on a plate.
Drizzle the warm gochujang sauce over the fish and sprinkle with thinly sliced green onions.
Serve the fish with the bokkeum (Korean stir-fry mix) on the side.
Optional: Drizzle with sesame oil for added flavor.
